patch_description:
Replace the degenerate all-zero output with a deterministic multi-start maximin construction in barycentric coordinates. In these coordinates, the absolute determinant of three point coordinates is exactly the triangle area normalized by the containing equilateral triangle area, so optimization directly targets the evaluation metric without numerical rescaling.

The search fixes the three container vertices, initializes the remaining eight points from reproducible Dirichlet samples, and applies annealed single-point perturbations projected back into the simplex. A lexicographic-style objective emphasizes the minimum triangle area while also increasing the small-area tail, which avoids stagnation caused by optimizing only one active triplet. The best feasible arrangement found across restarts is converted back to Cartesian coordinates.
